## About RICOH

To Our Stakeholders

Ricoh has remained close to the changing nature of work since its founding in 1936.
We will continue to drive innovation, support the creativity of working people, and realize
“Fulfillment through Work.”

# A Unified Way to Manage Records, Data, and Compliance

Access helps you simplify how you store, secure, retrieve, and govern information.

**Access Unify^{®}** delivers end-to-end information management—from storage and digitization to
governance and secure destruction. Manage your records, documents, and data with confidence.

[Start Today!][109]

## Solving Information Management Challenges for 30,000+ Clients

### AI Is Moving Into Everyday Work. Is Your Governance Ready?

Understand how AI regulation, Shadow AI, and AI-generated records are changing the way organizations
manage information, compliance, and risk.

AI rarely enters an organization through one door. It shows up in draft policies, meeting notes,
customer summaries, uploaded files, and decisions made with help from tools your teams may already
be using.

Over time, those prompts, outputs, logs, and AI-assisted decisions can contain sensitive information
or become records that need to be retained, protected, and managed. The challenge is knowing where
that risk appears, who owns it, and how to bring AI use into your broader information governance
strategy.

**In this eBook, you’ll learn:**
* How global AI regulation is developing across the EU
* Why Shadow AI creates risk
* Where AI-related risk appears across departments
* What to include in a practical AI governance framework

Download your copy to learn how to reduce risk, improve governance, and support responsible AI use
across your organization.

Without efficient processes in place, it can also become one of the most costly departments, in
time, money and resources.

From invoice and purchase order processing to data entry, reduce risk and regain full control of

enables information to be error-free, digitised, findable and readily available, therefore freeing
up your accounting team to focus on their key deliverables and improve service levels.

With AP Automation all processes are centrally managed, allowing you to easily adapt the way you
work to address threats or opportunities without any additional training or dependency on internal
IT. No matter how many invoices your organisation handles, Dajon can help you to reduce the time
your processes take, reduce costs and ultimately support you in the growth of your business.

# **Digital Conversion Services**

A digitizing company founded in 2007, DiJiFi helps clients across the globe digitize movies, film,
photos, and more. Our digital conversion services convert all forms of old media (photos, slides,
film, audio, videos, paper documents, books, microfilm, microfiche, etc.) into digital files,
allowing for convenient storage and the preservation of your cherished memories and important
documents. Over the course of 17 years, we have used our document, movie, photo, and film digitizing
services to transfer over 11,500,000 feet of film, over 8,500,000 photos, and over 1,500,000 hours
of video and audio recordings for clients small and large.

[ Get to know more about our company ][40]

### Check out some of our digitizing services below.

## Photo Services

### DiJiFi is recognized for our ability to provide high-quality media digitizing services for all
### photo formats and still images. We are capable of optimizing images in digital form, printing
### high-quality and archival images and saving your digital files to hard drives, discs or the
### cloud. We can also back up and add descriptive info to each image, which allows you to easily
### track and organize your images.

[ Learn more ][41]
 

> “DiJiFi was an amazing partner in preserving our memories in a professional and cost effective
> way. We are forever grateful for their integrity and customer service and follow through. They
> worked with us on pricing and completed the job exactly as they said they would. Thank you so
> much.”

— Rick Kaplan

### Old film lying around? VHS tapes? BetaMax? Vinyl you want on your computer finally? We digitize
### film of all kinds. DiJiFi provides film transfers for 16mm, 8mm, and Super 8 film, along with
### video transfers, audio transfers, and even data recovery and hard drive transfers. Let us
### digitize film for you to preserve your fondest recordings.

[ Learn more ][42]

> “Did a wonderful job transferring my parents 60 year old wedding film. 16mm silent. They knew the

HIPAA, Cyber Essentials)
Highlights
* 256-bit encryption
  This secures your data by converting it into a code that only authorized users can decipher,
  ensuring it is safe from unauthorized access. For example, this level of security is used by banks
  to protect financial information.

  addition to your password.

  Secure Sockets Layer connections encrypt the data transmitted between your browser and our data
  centers, ensuring that your information remains private and protected from interception. IP
  Restrictions add an extra layer by limiting where your account can be accessed from, giving you
  even more control over who can reach your documents — and from where.
  s SSL/TLS + IP restrictions
* Custom password policy
  Administrators can enforce custom password policies by defining rules for length, complexity, and
  expiration. Additionally, they can mandate the use of two-factor authentication to enhance
  security.
  s Custom password policy

  This ensures your data is redundantly stored across multiple locations, at least 100 km apart, for
  maximum safety and reliability. Even in the unlikely event of a failure at one site, your data
  remains secure and accessible.
  s Triple Backups

  This ensures that even if a user with delete permissions removes a file, it can still be reviewed
  and restored if needed. This adds an extra layer of security for all deleted data.

  policies, ensuring that users can easily and securely access resources while administrators
  maintain control over user permissions and data protection.

  to view existing content. This feature is perfect for scenarios where document submissions are
  required without granting access to other sensitive files.

  This permission level allows users to view documents, as well as print and download them.

  This permission level grants users full control over the shared resource, including the ability to
  view, edit, delete, and manage files and settings.
  s Editor

  This allows precise control over user actions, such as toggling audit trail visibility, enabling
  online editing only, and restricting downloads or other activities. This flexibility ensures that
  each user’s access aligns perfectly with their role and the security needs of the shared resource.
  s Granular (custom)

requirements.

Accurate conversion of scanned data into structured formats - Excel, database, ERP, and more.

## Document scanning & digitization — your questions answered

Straight answers on cost, timelines, security and formats — from a team that has digitized 300M+
pages.

How much does document digitization or scanning cost?

Document scanning is priced per page, and the rate depends on volume, paper condition, and whether
you need OCR or metadata indexing. Bulk and large-volume projects get volume discounts. Share your
page count and document type and we will send a transparent cost estimate within 24 hours.

How long does a document scanning project take?

Turnaround depends on volume and complexity. A few boxes are typically done within days; large
archives run in scheduled batches with progress reporting at every stage so you always know the
status.

Is my data kept confidential and secure?

Yes. Every project is covered by mutual and operator-level NDAs, with optional on-site scanning so
your documents never leave your premises. Workflows follow DPDP Act (India), HIPAA and ISO 27001
best practices, with encrypted storage and full audit trails.

What file formats do you deliver?

We deliver searchable PDF/PDF-A, TIFF, JPEG, JPEG2000, PNG, DOC, XLS and XML. With OCR enabled, your
scans become fully searchable and ready to drop into your DMS, ERP or SharePoint.

Do you offer on-site document scanning in Pune?

Yes. For confidential or large archives our team can scan on-site at your office in Pune and across
India, so original records never leave your control.

Can you handle bulk and large-volume document scanning?

Absolutely. Our high-speed production scanners run up to 200 pages per minute with batch separation
and barcoding, and we have digitized over 300 million pages since 2017 across government,
healthcare, legal and enterprise clients.

## Liberty Scanning – Your Complete Records Management Solution

Liberty Scanning is a trusted full-service records management company, helping businesses, medical
providers, law firms, schools, and government agencies take control of their information through
secure, efficient solutions. Our services cover the entire document lifecycle, including
high-quality scanning, secure digital archiving, and HIPAA-compliant on-site and mobile shredding.
We convert paper archives into fully searchable digital files, streamline storage, reduce physical
clutter, and provide instant access through our Liberty Cloud platform.

Security and compliance are at the core of everything we do. Operating secure facilities,
maintaining ISO 9001:2015 certification, and holding an A+ BBB rating, we ensure sensitive
information is handled with the highest level of care and accountability. Whether you need one-time
scanning and shredding or ongoing records management support, Liberty Scanning customizes solutions
to meet your organization’s needs, making us the trusted partner for complete records management.

information is handled with the highest level of care and accountability. Whether you need one-time
scanning and shredding or ongoing records management support, Liberty Scanning customizes solutions

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is NAPS2?

NAPS2, short for Not Another PDF Scanner 2, is a free and open-source software designed for scanning
documents into PDF and other formats. It provides a straightforward solution for users looking to
digitize physical documents.

How does NAPS2 differ from other PDF scanners?

NAPS2 stands out with its simplicity and efficiency. It offers a user-friendly interface, supports a
variety of scanners, and is known for its robust features while being open-source, making it a
cost-effective choice.

Is NAPS2 suitable for both personal and professional use?

Yes, NAPS2 is versatile and suitable for both personal and professional use. Whether you need to
digitize personal documents or manage paperwork in a professional setting, NAPS2 provides a reliable
solution.

Can I use NAPS2 with different types of scanners?

Absolutely. NAPS2 is compatible with a wide range of scanners, making it adaptable to various
hardware setups. Users can seamlessly integrate their preferred scanners with NAPS2 for efficient
document scanning.

What operating systems does NAPS2 support?

NAPS2 is compatible with Windows operating systems, providing a convenient solution for users on
Windows platforms.

Does NAPS2 offer any advanced scanning features?

Yes, NAPS2 includes advanced scanning features such as duplex scanning, color modes, and resolution
adjustments. These features enhance the scanning capabilities, making it a versatile tool for
different scanning needs.

Is NAPS2 free to use?

Yes, NAPS2 is open-source and free to use. Users can download and use the software without incurring
any costs, making it an accessible option for anyone looking for efficient document scanning.

How user-friendly is the NAPS2 interface?

NAPS2 is designed with a user-friendly interface, making it easy for both novice and experienced
users. The intuitive layout ensures a smooth scanning experience, with clear options for
customization.

Can NAPS2 handle OCR (Optical Character Recognition)?

Yes, NAPS2 supports OCR functionality, allowing users to convert scanned documents into editable
text. This feature adds value by making scanned content searchable and editable.

Are there any security features in NAPS2 to protect scanned documents?

While NAPS2 primarily focuses on scanning functionality, it is recommended to rely on additional
security measures for document protection. Users should implement secure document management
practices to ensure the confidentiality of scanned content.

# Free Online OCR Convert JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP, TIFF, PDF, DjVu to Text

Our free online OCR service allows you to quickly and easily convert scanned documents and images
into editable text, with no limits on the number of files you can upload. There's no need to
register for an account or install any software, making it easy to start using our OCR service right
away. Whether you need to extract text from a PDF, image, or other document, our OCR service is here
to help you work more efficiently. Try it now and see how our OCR service can make your life easier!
Choose your file for OCR processing
Preview 

### Features

Free online OCR service offers unlimited file uploads and does not require registration. Your data
is kept safe and secure with us, and all of your files will be removed from the server after use for
added privacy. Our service is based on the Tesseract OCR engine and supports 122 recognition
languages and fonts, making it ideal for multi-language recognition. It is also capable of
recognizing mathematical equations and analyzing page layouts for improved text recognition. You can
select a specific area on a page for OCR and rotate pages clockwise or counterclockwise in 90°, 180°
increments. After OCR processing, you have several options for displaying and processing the
resulting text, including downloading as a file, editing in Google Docs, translating with Google
Translate or Bing Translator, publishing online, copying to the clipboard, and more. Our service is
even able to handle poorly scanned and photographed pages and low-resolution images.


### Input file formats

Free online OCR service is able to process a wide range of input file formats, including popular
image formats such as JPEG, JFIF, PNG, GIF, BMP, PBM, PGM, PPM, and PCX. We can also handle
compressed files like Unix compress, bzip2, bzip, and gzip. For multi-page documents, we support
TIFF, PDF, and DjVu formats. In addition, our service is able to handle DOCX and ODT files with
images and multiple images within a ZIP archive, making it a versatile tool for all of your OCR
needs.


### Output file formats

Free online OCR service provides a variety of output file formats to meet your needs. Choose from
plain text (TXT), Microsoft Word (DOC), or Adobe Acrobat (PDF). No matter which format you choose,
you can trust that the resulting text will be accurate and easy to work with. Whether you need a
simple text document, a fully formatted Word document, or a professional-grade PDF, our OCR service
has you covered.

### Recognition languages

Free online OCR service offers recognition in a wide variety of languages, including Afrikaans,
Amharic, Arabic, Assamese, Azerbaijani, Belarusian, Bengali, Tibetan, Bosnian, Breton, Bulgarian,
Catalan, Valencian, Cebuano, Czech, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Cherokee, Welsh, Danish,
German, Dzongkha, Greek (Modern and Ancient), English, Esperanto, Estonian, Basque, Persian,
Finnish, French, Frankish, Irish, Galician, Gujarati, Haitian Creole, Hebrew, Hindi, Croatian,
Hungarian, Inuktitut, Indonesian, Icelandic, Italian, Javanese, Japanese, Kannada, Georgian, Kazakh,
Central Khmer, Kirghiz, Korean, Kurdish, Lao, Latin, Latvian, Lithuanian, Luxembourgish, Malayalam,
Marathi, Macedonian, Maltese, Mongolian, Maori, Malay, Burmese, Nepali, Dutch, Norwegian, Occitan,
Oriya, Panjabi, Polish, Portuguese, Pushto, Quechua, Romanian, Russian, Sanskrit, Sinhala, Slovak,
Slovenian, Sindhi, Spanish, Albanian, Serbian, Sundanese, Swahili, Swedish, Syriac, Tamil, Tatar,
Telugu, Tajik, Tagalog, Thai, Tigrinya, Tonga, Turkish, Uighur, Ukrainian, Urdu, Uzbek, Vietnamese,
Yiddish, and Yoruba. In addition, we offer a math/equation detection module for your specialized OCR
needs.

# 3D Laser scanning · BIM Coordination · virtual construction · digital delivery & implementation

## Bespoke digital delivery for the AEC industry.

OAR provides 3D Laser Scanning, BIM Coordination & Virtual Construction, and Digital Delivery &
Implementation for teams that need verified data and coordinated models to build from.

[ Explore Our Services ][9]
[ Send Us a Message ][10]
Our approach

## Laser scanning is our foundation. What we do with the data is what sets us apart.

We don’t hand over deliverables and walk away. Every service OAR provides runs on the same
principle: your data should change something in the field. We understand the why behind the scan,
and we stay with your project and use the data to drive better outcomes.

01

### Reduce project risk

Verified spatial data eliminates costly field conflicts before they happen. Our coordination catches
clashes when they’re still lines on a screen.

02

### Accelerate delivery

Model-driven workflows compress review cycles and keep trades coordinated. Fewer RFIs, faster
approvals, fewer surprises at turnover.

03

### Make the data actionable

From a single scan to a full digital twin, we translate raw capture into insights your operations
team can act on.

04

### Full-chain accountability

We manage the entire workflow. Hardware, software, coordination, and delivery. Your team doesn’t
have to figure it out alone.

What we do

## Three services. One partner.

Our three services connect into one integrated workflow.

[1 2][1 2]

### Capture what's actually there.

Our 3D Laser Scanning service mobilizes to your site and captures exact as-built conditions using
high-accuracy laser scanners. The result is a verified point cloud your engineers, architects, and
contractors can build from. No assumptions. No outdated drawings.

### Reality capture, built around what you do next.

From industrial MRFs to multi-story commercial projects, our 3D Laser Scanning workflow starts with
one question: what does your team need to do with this data? We deliver point clouds, Revit models,
2D documentation, and as-built packages. One integrated workflow.
[ Explore 3D Laser Scanning → ][11]
[2 2][2 2]

### Coordinate before you build.

Our BIM Coordination & Virtual Construction service builds and coordinates multi-trade BIM models
from point cloud data or design drawings. Every spatial conflict is identified and resolved before
fabrication begins.

### Clash-free models. Construction-ready outcomes.

BIM Coordination & Virtual Construction at OAR covers the full process: BEP development, Revit model
build, clash detection across all trades, coordination meetings and construction verification and
installation support. Or we step into your existing BIM environment and handle targeted clash
resolution. .
[ Explore BIM Coordination & Virtual Construction → ][12]
[3 2][3 2]

### From data to decisions.

Our Digital Delivery & Implementation service connects data environments, builds digital twins, and
structures closeout packages. We consult to develop, train, and deploy cutting-edge, high impact
construction technology for our clients that they can use moving forward.

### Data that outlasts the project.

Digital Delivery & Implementation is about making your project data work after close-out. How do you
extract real value from digital deliverables? How do you tailor them to your client's needs, your
industry, your project type? Or how do you ensure that your capabilities stack up with other
advanced project partners? OAR is your resource to develop digital delivery and virtual construction
practices.
[ Explore Digital Delivery & Implementation → ][13]

machine-readable passports were published in 1980, and the technology was quickly adopted globally.
By 2015, the ICAO had phased out all non-machine-readable passports among its 193 member states.

documents such as national ID cards and driving licences. It consists of three lines, each with 30
characters. Type 2 is rare and used for some travel documents that fall between the size of an ID
card and a passport booklet. It has two lines of 30 characters each. Type 3 is used for standard
passport booklets. It features two lines, each with 44 characters — the format most people encounter
when travelling internationally. This standardisation is what makes MRZ so powerful. Because every
compliant document uses the same format, OCR systems can be trained to extract the right data fields
every time, regardless of which country issued the document or what language it is written in.

Every time someone crosses a border, checks into a flight, opens a bank account, or verifies their
identity online, there is a small strip of text doing a significant amount of work behind the
scenes. It sits quietly at the bottom of passports, ID cards, and travel documents the world over.
It looks like a line of scrambled characters — and yet it carries everything a system needs to
verify who someone is in a matter of milliseconds. This is the Machine Readable Zone, or MRZ. And
understanding how it works is key to understanding modern identity verification. What Is a Machine
Readable Zone? A Machine Readable Zone is a standardised section found at the bottom of identity
documents — most commonly on the photo page of a passport or the reverse side of an ID card. It
contains the document holder's core personal data encoded in a format that machines can read
instantly using optical character recognition (OCR) technology. The information encoded in the MRZ
typically includes the document type, the issuing country, the document number, the holder's full
name, date of birth, nationality, gender, and the document's expiry date. It also includes check
digits — a mathematical verification mechanism that allows systems to detect whether any part of the
MRZ has been tampered with or forged. The MRZ is not new technology. The International Civil
Aviation Organization (ICAO) began its work on machine-readable travel documents in 1968, with the
aim of speeding up passenger clearance at border control. The first specifications for
machine-readable passports were published in 1980, and the technology was quickly adopted globally.
By 2015, the ICAO had phased out all non-machine-readable passports among its 193 member states.
Today, every internationally accepted travel document uses MRZ. What Does the MRZ Actually Look
Like? The MRZ appears as two or three lines of text at the bottom of the document, consisting of
uppercase letters, numbers, and the filler character "<". To the human eye it looks like noise. To a
machine, it is a precisely structured data field. The ICAO standardises three MRZ formats, defined
in Document 9303, which all 193 member states adhere to: Type 1 is used for credit card-sized
documents such as national ID cards and driving licences. It consists of three lines, each with 30
characters. Type 2 is rare and used for some travel documents that fall between the size of an ID
card and a passport booklet. It has two lines of 30 characters each. Type 3 is used for standard
passport booklets. It features two lines, each with 44 characters — the format most people encounter
when travelling internationally. This standardisation is what makes MRZ so powerful. Because every
compliant document uses the same format, OCR systems can be trained to extract the right data fields
every time, regardless of which country issued the document or what language it is written in.

a bank branch. The optical sensor captures an image of the MRZ. Step two: extraction. OCR technology
